title: Employee Detail Breakdown Sign And Worker-Deduction Safety
description: Ensure employee detail breakdown shows negative-source deductions and does not use employer totals as worker deductions.

implementation.description: Add failing tests for negative pot_koreksi/koreksi_* and for ASTEK worker vs majikan vs jumlah precedence.
implementation.expected_failure: Negative deductions are omitted or total ASTEK is used as worker deduction.

implementation.description: Normalize deduction magnitudes with Math.abs and prefer worker-only deduction fields before any jumlah total fallback.
Introduce a small helper for deductionMagnitude and replace repeated amount > 0 checks.
